nodes.label: Android Monochrome Icon (432x432)
nodes.description: 432x432 RGBA monochrome/grayscale icon for Android themed icons (Android 13+). Mostly transparent (92.5%) with mid-gray (rgb(125,125,125)) opaque content. Single-color silhouette for use with Android's themed icon system.

edges.note: Monochrome version of the Android adaptive icon for Android 13+ themed icons
